{"metadata":{"description":"Generic LLM gateway provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness: newapi / LiteLLM / Higress / any OpenAI-compatible gateway, multi-protocol (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) via pi-ai SDK, models.dev enrichment","id":"gh:1333427828","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-gateway-provider","slug":"Luck9Star/dsh-gateway-provider","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","litellm","llm-provider","newapi","pi-ai"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Generic LLM gateway provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness: newapi / LiteLLM / Higress / any OpenAI-co"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"mpatible gateway, multi-protocol (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) via pi-ai SDK, models.dev enrichment"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-gateway-provider"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> 中文文档：docs/README.zh.md"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Use **all the models behind your LLM gateway** — newapi, LiteLLM, Higress,
or any OpenAI-compatible "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"endpoint — directly in DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Install the plugin, paste your API key, and every gateway model shows up in
dsh's model picker with "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"its **real** parameters (context window, output cap,
reasoning support) fetched from models.dev. Req"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"uests
go out over each model's own native protocol — OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini
— so tool calls an"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"d streaming behave the way that model's maker intended."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"dsh ships one adapter per official provider. If your models live behind a
gateway, the manual altern"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ative is a hand-maintained static model list with
guessed context windows and output caps. This plug"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"in mounts the gateway
itself instead:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Nothing to maintain by hand** — the model list is read from the gateway
(`GET /v1/models`, with "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"a management-API fallback for newapi); add a model
on the gateway side and it appears in dsh, no re-"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"deploy.
- **Real numbers, not guesses** — models.dev data fills context window,
output cap, reasonin"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"g levels, release date; config defaults only fill gaps.
- **Every wire format, one plugin** — each m"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"odel routes over its own
protocol (OpenAI chat completions / OpenAI responses / Anthropic messages
/"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" Gemini), handled by the same
pi-ai SDK the
official dsh adapter uses.
- **Multiple gateways at once"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"** — a default `newapi` route plus one
`gateway:<id>` route per extra gateway, each with its own cac"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"he and key.
- **A settings page instead of YAML** — **Settings → Gateway Models**: add
gateways from"},{"id":"p8s9","text":" templates (NewAPI / LiteLLM / Higress / OpenAI-compatible /
fully custom), test connections, sync m"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"odels, hide or override any model,
add custom models."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with a `web` profile (the settings page is a web-UI
extension; the provider"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" itself works in any profile).
- A gateway API key (e.g. a newapi token)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Expected result:** the model picker gains a "NewAPI" route listing your

cloud? Set **Base URL** on the card (or `baseURL` in config) to your own
gateway "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"wapi
cloud? Set **Base URL** on the card (or `baseURL` in config) to your own

Connection Test / Sync / p"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"er-model editing still need the web settings page
(or hand-edits of the YAML above). A future in-ter"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"minal settings surface

may cover the scalar fields; until then the Y"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"AML override is the supported
path."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Daily use"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Everything lives in **Settings → Gateway Models**:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Add more gateways** — "Add Gateway", pick a template (LiteLLM, Higress,

- **Tame the model list** — non-chat models (image / s"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"peech / embedding /

context window, output cap, and reasoni"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"ng levels are all editable.

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## How it works (one minute version)"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"At startup the plugin registers one provider route per gateway, pulls the
model list from the gatewa"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"y, and fuzzy-matches each model id against
models.dev to fill in real parameters. When you pick a mo"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"del, dsh's request
is translated to the pi-ai SDK's format and sent over that model's native
protoco"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"l; the streamed reply is translated back into dsh chunks. Catalogs
are cached (30 min by default) pe"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"r gateway. No hand-written protocol code —
the bridge is lifted from the official `dsh-llm-pi-ai` ad"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"way. No hand-written protocol code —
the bridge is lifted from the official `dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Why the plugin pins its own pi-ai"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"`@earendil-works/pi-ai` is a direct dependency (exact-pinned), independent of
the pi-ai version bund"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"led with the harness. This decouples the gateway model
catalog (thinking levels, per-provider compat"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" such as zhipu GLM's
`supportsDeveloperRole: false`) from harness upgrades: a model missing from
the"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" harness's older catalog no longer degrades request encoding. The
plugin↔harness boundary passes pla"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"in data (`GenerateOptions` in, dsh
`StreamChunk`s out; `lib/pi-bridge.js` never leaks pi-ai objects "},{"id":"p30s6","text":"across), so
the plugin's pi-ai copy and the harness's own coexist safely in one process."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Developing from a checkout: point the profile's `package.json` at
`"dsh-gateway-provider": "link:/ab"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"s/path"` and re-run `pnpm install` in the
profile. Do **not** also add an `id: llm-newapi` row to th"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"e profile's own
`cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch already provides it (duplicate row =
loader er"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"file's own
`cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch already provides it (duplicate row =
loader error)."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Keys live in dsh's credential store or the launching environment — never in
settings YAML. The repo "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"runs gitleaks
in CI and pre-commit to keep secrets out."}],"truncated":true}
